savedinstancestate super. activitymain3 viewcompat. bottom return insets the idea is to use your phone to detect your driving habits. you can start this app, put it on your vehicle, probably on the dashboard of your car or mount it on your bike and the app will record following violations and press start button on your screen violations harsh breaking whenever you push the breaks too harshly. strong acceleration when you accelerate the car too much harsh turning when the vehicle is turned in a high speed over speeding when your vehicle goes beyond 80kmh app features every time you press start, a new trip is started and every trip will have its own set of violations and events. the trip and its violations will be stored to internal storage to be reviewed later. when the trip is over, the trip and violations can be viewed from trips list screen. all these violations will be recorded with date, time and exact location. once the trip is over, user will press stop and your violations will be displayed on the screen. every screen will show a banner ad at the bottom and an interstitial ad when going from one screen to another. when we are driving, there are times when we cannot avoid harsh breaking, but we record it anyway. it is dangerous to turn on high speeds and its dangerous and inefficient on fuel and tough on your vehicle to accelerate quickly. this app later can be improved and can be used to track activity of drivers who use your vehicle in your absence. screen flow the app is mainly 3 screens. home screen home screen shows 3 buttons as shown in ui and current trips details. current trip violations continue to get added to this screen. user can click start to start a trip and click stop to finish the trip. and save trip user can click trips to go to trips screen.

1.document: home screen shows 3 buttons as shown in ui and current trips details. current trip violations continue to get added to this screen. user can click start to start a trip and click stop to finish the trip. and save trip user can click trips to go to trips screen. trips screen this screen shows the list of trips weve recorded, all trips recorded in the past. each entry shows the date of trip start user can click a trip to see trip detail trip detail screen this screen shows list of violations, each violation has datetime and a map button user can click view map button to launch google maps to see exact location where this violation happened.
